subject: English
stimulus: (a) It was Gulliver who ⎯⎯. (b) He lay down on the grass ⎯⎯. (c) ⎯⎯ it was daylight. (d) He attempted to rise ⎯⎯. (e) He was fastened to the ground lest ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) It was Gulliver who fell victim to a shipwreck. (b) I lay down on the grass because I was very tired. (c) When I woke up, it was daylight. (d) He attempted to rise but could not move. (e) He was fastened to the ground lest he should do any harm to them.
